1. (1) Perintah ini bolehlah dinamakan Perintah Fi (Planetarium

Negara) 2018.

(2) Perintah ini mula berkuat kuasa pada 30 Julai 2018.

Fi

2. (1) Fi yang ditetapkan dalam ruang (2) Jadual Pertama hendaklah dikenakan

oleh Pengarah Planetarium Negara bagi butiran yang dinyatakan dalam ruang (1)

Jadual Pertama.

(2) Fi yang ditetapkan dalam ruang (2) Jadual Kedua hendaklah dikenakan

oleh Pengarah Planetarium Negara bagi sewaan kemudahan yang dinyatakan dalam

ruang (1) Jadual Kedua.

Pembayaran fi

3. Fi yang ditetapkan di bawah Perintah ini hendaklah dibayar kepada Pengarah

Planetarium Negara.

Peremitan

4. Pengarah Planetarium Negara boleh, menurut budi bicaranya dalam

mana-mana hal tertentu, meremitkan keseluruhan atau sebahagian daripada

mana-mana fi yang ditetapkan di bawah Perintah ini.

Pembatalan

5. Perintah Fee (Planetarium Negara) 1997 [P.U. (A) 461/1997] dibatalkan.

FEES ACT 1951

FEES (NATIONAL PLANETARIUM) ORDER 2018

IN exercise of the powers conferred by sections 3 and 10 of

the Fees Act 1951 [Act 209], the Yang di-Pertuan Agong makes the following order:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) This order may be cited as the Fees (National Planetarium)

Order 2018.

(2) This Order comes into operation on 30 July 2018.

Fees

2. (1) The fees prescribed in column (2) of the First Schedule shall be charged

by the Director of National Planetarium for the items specified in column (1) of the

First Schedule.

(2) The fees prescribed in column (2) of the Second Schedule shall be charged

by the Director of National Planetarium for rental of facilities specified in column (1) of

the Second Schedule.

Payment of fees

3. The fees prescribed under this Order shall be paid to the Director of

National Planetarium.

Remission

4. The Director of National Planetarium may, in his discretion in any particular

case, remit wholly or in part any fees prescribed under this Order.

Revocation

5. The Fees (National Planetarium) Order 1997 [P.U. (A) 461/1997] is revoked.
